ticket: Allow ordering as a gift, sending the confirmation to a different recipient email.
notes: Order has a single customerEmail used for confirmation; refunds and future emails assume it is the payer. Gift semantics, prices in the email, and refund routing are open.

criticalAmbiguities.description: Whether the recipient or the buyer gets the confirmation, and whether prices are shown to a gift recipient.
Refund and other later emails: buyer or recipient.
Order has only customerEmail; a recipient field is a model change.

unacceptableAssumptions.description: Silently hiding prices from the recipient.
